This is a blind usability evaluation of Somite. Work only through tools exposed by the Somite MCP server; do not use shell commands, direct filesystem reads, or tools from other servers. On the current canvas, build a paired-end read QC workflow. Add one paired local FASTQ source with R1 path fixtures/eval_R1.fastq.gz and R2 path fixtures/eval_R2.fastq.gz, add fastp configured for 2 threads, and connect both mates to the correct ports. Use exact catalog contracts and immutable revisions; do not invent identifiers. Keep the edit coherent and atomic. Then start representative validation and poll it to a terminal phase. Report the operations, current state and graph revisions, terminal validation status or evidence, and any exact blocker. Never claim the workflow is runnable unless validation completed successfully. Do not ask questions unless a permission decision is genuinely required.
